head: codex/4647-v0917-review-remediation-preflight
title: [v0.91.7][WP-20] Remediate external review findings (#4647)
body:
Closes #4647

Records WP-20 remediation of the retained WP-19 external review findings for v0.91.7.

Highlights:
- Retains the exact external finding-validation artifact and WP-19 remediation matrix.
- Fixes Bedrock account pinning and diagnostic redaction, provider artifact retry safety, coverage profile isolation, CSM redaction/path hygiene, local provider edge cases, and current milestone documentation truth.
- Updates coverage-impact mappings so provider setup/local-provider and CSM networking changes select narrow PR-fast coverage filters instead of failing closed as unmapped Rust sources.
- Final clean gate at c8a889da501760e0e9270933023bb72b63117916: delta reviewer clean, coverage exact-head lane clean, lifecycle/full branch exact-head lane clean, csdlc-doctor passed at generation 15, all changed paths protected, and worktree clean.
- Post-publication mapping fix at 3f250321dba93a94419b2880baa1905ede9204c5 was reviewed clean/fixed-confirmed by subagent 019f7df0-b305-7403-84db-b4a82cf26d1d.

Validation:
- Focused WP-20 validation is recorded in the SOR and remediation matrix.
- Bedrock sanitizer partition coverage: 4 focused tests passed on FastWork.
- bash adl/tools/test_check_coverage_impact.sh passed after the PR-fast mapping fix.
- PR-style coverage-impact expression now includes provider, cli::provider_cmd::tests, and csm_networking selectors.
- csdlc-doctor passed for #4647 after corrected review recording at generation 21.

CI handling:
- GitHub run 29718251274 was canceled immediately after the early adl-coverage-hosted failure to avoid continuing failed work.

Non-claims:
- No AWS live operation was run.
- This does not reopen WP-18.
- WP-23 remains separate until WP-20 is merged and closed.
